subject.title: feat(cloud-workers): pinned SSH tunnel runtime and provider-owned key resolution

question: Should this milestone-1 SSH security boundary merge before the Crabbox host-key companion and milestone-2 caller exist, once live static-SSH proof is added?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and fail-closed, but maintainers must explicitly accept staging a public plugin/protocol security boundary whose production Crabbox path remains unavailable until external companion work ships.

options.title: Merge after live static-SSH proof
options.body: Accept the staged boundary after a real pinned tunnel run and an explicit link to the Crabbox host-key companion establish the upgrade and dependency story.

options.title: Wait for Crabbox companion
options.body: Hold the PR until authoritative `sshHostKey` output is implemented and the complete Crabbox path can be demonstrated.

options.title: Wait for milestone 2
options.body: Keep the tunnel private to the series until its first production caller can prove the end-to-end worker communication path.

recommendation.title: Merge after live static-SSH proof
recommendation.body: Accept the staged boundary after a real pinned tunnel run and an explicit link to the Crabbox host-key companion establish the upgrade and dependency story.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature owner authored and merged the preceding cloud-worker milestones and is best positioned to choose whether this boundary should stage independently.
